units.raw_text: Owned the migration of Pliant's monolithic Rails app to a TypeScript-Node services architecture for the workflow execution path. Designed the service split, ran the dual-write window for six weeks, and cut median workflow execution latency from 1.2s to 280ms; old code path retired three months later.

units.raw_text: Led the multi-tenant data-export feature end-to-end — schema design, Postgres COPY-based pipeline, S3 hand-off, signed download URLs, and the customer-facing UI. Feature shipped on the deadline tied to a Fortune 500 procurement requirement and unblocked a $1.4M ACV deal.
